# Functional Forms

::: {.callout-tip}
### Learning Objectives
- Understand why functional form choices matter for empirical results
- Interpret coefficients in linear, log-linear, and nonlinear models
- Recognize when transformations improve model fit and interpretation
:::

::: {.callout-important}
### Key Takeaways
- Different functional forms can imply very different economic interpretations
- Logarithmic transformations often stabilize variance and simplify interpretation
- Model fit and economic theory should jointly guide functional form choices
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
### Common Pitfalls
- Choosing functional forms solely based on statistical fit
- Misinterpreting coefficients after nonlinear transformations
- Ignoring economic theory when specifying functional relationships
:::

## Motivation

Why functional forms matter in applied econometrics.

## Model

Formal setup and identifying assumptions.

## Interpretation

How to interpret estimates in practice.
